note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions alone: story order first, then side strands, activities, collectibles and world, crime, money and misc, with 100% completion and the platinum last. Missable flags come from the descriptions that describe a one-time setup (partner present, a specific place, a choice, a rare event).

stages.goal: Finish the story: the opening mission, Chapters 1–4, the named missions and the finale.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story

stages.goal: Close every side strand: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, the 8 stranger strands and Bret's hunt.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Side strands

stages.goal: Clear the activities: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 20 race wins, 14 drone-race locations, fishing, arcade, bowling and all 18 meditation spots.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Activities and skills

stages.goal: Sweep the world: 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, 50 challenges, 100 vehicles discovered and all 52 areas of Leonida explored.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Collectibles and exploration

stages.goal: Do the crime set: vaults, armored trucks, gang operations, Combat Focus, jewelry-store stealth — and the missable setups (partner heat, shop runs, VCIA exit, showroom smash) while the story still offers them.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Crime and chaos

stages.goal: Finish the money and moment trophies: launder $250,000, spend $100,000, buy all 8 garages, register 10 vehicles, and catch the one-time moments (cocktail on Ocean Beach, partnership moment, choices, second try, strange event, melee drive-by).
stages.title: Stage 6 — Money and loose ends

stages.goal: Reach 100% completion, then the platinum pops on its own.
stages.title: Stage 7 — 100% and the platinum

tips: Do the missable setups during the story, while your partner and the locations are available — see the Missables view for all 8.
Missions can be replayed, so chapter and mission trophies cannot be missed; the 8 flagged trophies are the ones with a one-time setup.
Keep a separate save before the finale and before big choice moments.
Fold WAiNK, vehicle discovery and meditation spots into normal travel instead of grinding them at the end.
